Fueling components NREL implemented a Cognex In-Sight 7000 Series Camera that can be integrated with the robot programming (Figure 24). Camera research included research into symbol recognition. NREL also had access to high pressure fueling nozzles including a grip type (WEH) and push-pull type (Walther) for testing and determining which technology would be more suitable for robotic connection, shown in Figure 25.
